description: This file is a Perl module script for setting a new password for a user in the Coocook application. It defines a class with methods to interactively read a new password, verify it, and update the user record in the database.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Passwd
classes.description: A class representing a script to change a user's password in the Coocook system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to prompt for a new password, verify it, and update the user record.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line of input from the user with no echo, used for password input.
